summary: Iteration 33: tested the reworked 'Le tue misure' (real tape measurements only, no photo estimate). Backend: 22/22 pytest pass (validation 422 on each missing/out-of-range field, save returns method tape + measured_at + brand_sizes + complete true, optional weight/age/gender, complete=false for method auto_photo, size/recommend shows 'Completa le tue misure' then a letter, product/analyze + analyze-text return 400 'Completa le tue misure', avatar upload returns only {avatar} and leaves measurements alone, quick-estimate/auto-measure/tape-calibration give 404/405, reminder_due >60 days, 7-day snooze, saving clears the snooze). Frontend: Profile title and avatar note match exactly. All 8 inputs work. Each of the 6 guides opens with the right title and figure, the tape loops (mgDraw 5s infinite) and the close button works. Invalid save shows red fields and the toast 'Controlla i campi evidenziati' without calling the API. Valid save shows the toast 'Misure salvate sul tuo account', brand-sizes-result with 6 brands, and top S / bottom M. Values persist after reload. Top/bottom show 'Completa le tue misure' when incomplete. Dashboard avatar note, shoot-now (camera opens) and gallery warnings 1 and 2 work (tested with Annulla, nothing uploaded). Reminder popup (mocked with page.route) works on /wardrobe: Modifica ora goes to /profile and closes it; Ricordamelo dopo calls snooze, closes it and shows a toast. Calcola taglia with incomplete measures shows a toast and goes to /profile. OnboardingGate runs its 3 steps (name -> MeasuresForm with guides -> AvatarBox) and both skips work. No 'gioc' text found on any page. Main remaining problem: leftover texts still say measurements/sizes come from the photo (Termini, GalleryWarning).

minor.issue: Two accuracy numbers disagree. With incomplete (auto_photo) measures, Profile FittingAccuracy shows 70% 'Affidabile: Sì' + 'Dati completi.' while the size says 'Completa le tue misure'. After a valid save Profile shows 100% but the Dashboard badge shows 85%. _compute_accuracy only takes off 30 for incomplete, so it stays at 'reliable', and missing_fields is empty because the values exist even though method != tape.
The 422 detail is pydantic English; the frontend shows detail[0].msg (English). It is only reachable if client validation is bypassed, so low priority.

ui_bugs.issue: After saving MeasuresForm with a new weight, WeightTracker 'Peso attuale' stays stale (showed 70 after saving 66) until the page is reloaded. Profile onSaved does not refresh WeightTracker.
When it navigates to /profile on 'Completa le tue misure', the scroll position is kept, so the user lands on the weight tracker instead of the form. Scroll to top or to measures-form.

issues: Terms.jsx line ~92: 'il metodo di stima delle misure tramite analisi fotografica' (visible on /termini)

GalleryWarning.jsx step 1: 'misurazioni e vestibilità potrebbero non essere attendibili' and step 2: 'misure e taglie suggerite potrebbero essere sbagliate'. The photo no longer affects measures or sizes; reword to try-on realism. These texts may have been dictated by the user earlier, so confirm with them.
The label 'Lunghezza gamba' plus 'Guarda come' wraps onto 2 lines, so that input sits lower than the Vita/Fianchi row. Use a shorter label or whitespace-nowrap and items-end.
The Avatar3D tick labels are in English ('chest', 'waist', 'hips') in an Italian UI.
When incomplete, it reads '· tua taglia Completa le tue misure', which is awkward.
'La foto avatar serve solo per la prova vestiti' appears twice (step subtitle + AvatarBox notes).

action_items: Remove or reword the photo-based measurement texts in Terms.jsx (analisi fotografica) and GalleryWarning.jsx (misurazioni/misure e taglie)
Make FittingAccuracy consistent with completeness (not 'Affidabile: Sì'/'Dati completi' when method != tape) and align the Profile (100/70) and Dashboard (85) values
Restore owner measurements from measurements_backup_owner (owner measurements are currently in a test state: method auto_photo, values 172/94/78/98/44/80)
critical_code_review_comments: The pytest avatar upload exposed a risk: set_avatar calls _mark_files_deleted -> _erase_object on the old avatar, so any test upload on the owner permanently erases the real avatar. The test detaches avatar_path before uploading and restores it afterwards; the owner avatar is intact. One orphan test avatar object may remain in storage (marked is_deleted in db.files).
PUT /api/profile/measurements (legacy) is still open and removes method/brand_sizes, which silently makes the user incomplete. Remove it if no longer used.
ReminderPopup 'Modifica ora' doesn't snooze, so the popup shows again on every app open until the user saves. This may be intended.
seed_data_creation: Test session t1_test_* inserted and deleted afterwards. Test weight_history 'Misure reali' entries were deleted, reminder_snoozed_until was unset, and display_name 'Andrea' was restored through onboarding. Owner measurements were left in the test 'incomplete' state, so the main agent must restore them from the backup.

Use tests/_set_owner_meas_state.py incomplete|complete to switch the UI state. Auth is the cookie session_token on the preview domain plus localStorage atelier_owner=1. Mock reminder_due with page.route on **/api/profile/avatar. Never POST /profile/avatar for the owner without detaching avatar_path first (the old avatar gets erased).
